offer.title: The offer
offer.firmValue: It cannot be withdrawn before {date} (c.c. art. 1329).

pdf.title: The quote document
pdf.code: Document code {code} — your acceptance records exactly this document.
pdf.none: The PDF is not available here; the email has it attached.
pdf.problem: The PDF couldn't be shown here. It is attached to the email, and you can still answer.

OPEN.title: Open until {date}
OPEN.body: {seller} is waiting for your answer: accept it below by typing your name, or decline it.
OPEN.firm: A firm offer: {seller} cannot withdraw it before the date. Accept it below by typing your name, or decline it.

EXPIRED.title: This offer ended on {date}
EXPIRED.body: It can no longer be accepted. Ask {seller} for a new link if you still want it.

REVISING.title: A new version is being prepared
REVISING.body: {seller} is changing this quote; you will get a new link when it is ready.

SUPERSEDED.title: This quote was replaced by a newer version
SUPERSEDED.body: {seller} sent you a newer version with its own link. Ask for it again if you cannot find it.

DECLINED.title: You declined this quote
DECLINED.body: {seller} has your answer. Write to them if you change your mind.

CANCELLED.title: This quote was withdrawn
CANCELLED.body: {seller} withdrew it. Write to them if you still need an offer.

newLink.asked: We told {seller}: they will send you a new link.

sign.title: Accept quote {number} version {revision}
sign.summaryDeposit: You accept quote {number} version {revision}: {total}, with a deposit of {deposit}.
sign.legal: By typing your name you accept this quote from {seller} and its terms (version {version}).
sign.retention: We keep your name, the time, the document code and the terms version as proof of the acceptance.
sign.ackTerms: I have read and accept the terms and conditions (version {version}).
sign.ackNoWithdrawal: I know there is no right of withdrawal for made-to-measure goods (Codice del Consumo art. 59(c)).
sign.name: Full name
sign.nameHint: As you sign it; case and accents do not matter.
sign.emailHint: The address this link was sent to.
sign.emailInvalid: This does not look like an email address

done.title: Accepted — thank you, {name}
done.copy: We send you a copy by email.
done.name: Name
done.stepConfirm: We confirm the order within one working day.

deposit.title: Deposit by bank transfer
deposit.noBank: The bank details follow by email.
deposit.production: Production starts when the deposit is received.

decline.title: Decline this quote
decline.body: Tell us why, so we can do better; the seller sees your answer.
decline.name: Full name

problem.unavailable: This link can no longer be used.
problem.wrongPerson: The name or email does not match the person this link was sent to.
problem.changed: The quote changed meanwhile: it was read again. Check it and answer again.
problem.invalid: Some answer is missing: check the ticks, your name and your email.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
problem.unavailableNow: The service is not answering. Try again in a moment.
